name: decktective
description: Real-time visualizer for Pioneer Pro DJ Link decks (CDJ/XDJ): waveforms, metadata and player state
author: Virgile Pornet

scripts.dev:sim: node scripts/with-openssl.mjs cross-env DECKTECTIVE_SIM=1 tauri dev
scripts.dev:sim4: node scripts/with-openssl.mjs cross-env DECKTECTIVE_SIM=1 DECKTECTIVE_SIM_DECKS=4 tauri dev
scripts.dev:sim:recorded: node scripts/with-openssl.mjs cross-env DECKTECTIVE_SIM=1 DECKTECTIVE_SIM_DECKS=4 DECKTECTIVE_SIM_TRACKS=../crates/decktective-core/fixtures/sim-tracks.json tauri dev
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run test && node scripts/with-openssl.mjs tauri build
